cases.sql: SELECT tenant_id, status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(total) AS gross_total FROM orders WHERE created_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY tenant_id, status ORDER BY tenant_id, status

SELECT c.region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers, SUM(o.total) AS gross FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.region HAVING SUM(o.total) > 1000 ORDER BY gross DESC, c.region
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(CAST(total AS DECIMAL(18, 2))) AS avg_total FROM orders WHERE total BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
